result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer receives a 30-day convenience-termination right and a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while Vendor has no convenience-termination right during a term. However, “in whole or in part” and especially “without ... further liability” go beyond the playbook and could affect accrued payment or other surviving obligations. The Vendor restriction should also refer to a “committed term,” and the refund could be stated expressly as pro rata.
